title: AI Chatbots Lead Hikers Astray in the Backcountry
excerpt: Relying on artificial intelligence for outdoor trip planning can cause people to lose critical thinking, leading to dangerous consequences.
body_html:
Using artificial intelligence tools to plan outdoor excursions can create serious safety risks for individuals in remote areas. According to recent concerns, delegating trip planning tasks to AI systems often causes people to stop using their own critical thinking skills.

This reliance on automated planners can result in potentially fatal outcomes, particularly in environments like the backcountry where proper preparation and accurate navigation are essential for survival. Experts warn that treating chatbot suggestions as infallible guidance in wilderness settings introduces unnecessary hazards for hikers and explorers.
